title: Resilient Cost-Tuner Recovery Playbook and Recommendation Vetting
creator: Ava Chen
description: This ticket captures the incident follow-up and a prescriptive runbook for the Optimize auto-tuner where an aggressive batching/caching recommendation was applied and caused a production latency spike and transient error amplification for a subset of tenant traffic. The goal is to codify safe vetting, staged apply and rollback primitives, plus a verification harness for future recommendations so the tuner can deliver cost improvements without user-visible regressions.
postmortem_summary: On 2026-02-27 the optimizer pushed a recommendation profile that increased batch target sizes and enabled prefix-KV caching for several models. During the staged rollout the change bypassed a critical latency verifier and hit a high-concurrency tenant traffic pattern, producing 3x p95 latency for 12 minutes and increased 5xx rate for 4% of requests. No data loss. Root causes: 1) recommendation scoring favored cost impact over latency risk for tail-heavy workloads, 2) the 'quick-apply' path lacked a shadow verification step for real traffic, 3) automatic rollback thresholds were insufficiently sensitive to p95 and error-rate spikes concurrently.
mitigation_steps: Immediate: Reverted recommendation and reinstated previous profile (t=+14m)
Short-term: Increased monitoring and injected a temporary circuit-breaker limiting applied batch scale for high-concurrency tenants
Medium-term: Implement canary+shadow verification (see playbook), augment telemetry thresholds with combined p95+error-rate rules
Long-term: Update tuner scoring to include a tail-latency risk penalty and require a dry-run risk score below threshold before apply
playbook_steps: 1) PRE-APPLY: Run simulator with 3 traffic slices (baseline, tail-heavy synthetic, tenant-stress capture) and produce latency-cost delta report
2) DRY-RUN SHADOW: Deploy recommendation in shadow mode for 2% of traffic for 30 minutes with explicit KV-cache warmup disabled; collect p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and token-cost metrics
3) VERIFY: Apply automated checks: (a) p95 delta < 15% AND (b) absolute p95 < SLA-p95 OR (c) error-rate delta < 0.5% — all three must be satisfied; otherwise abort
4) STAGED APPLY: If DRY-RUN passes, roll out in three waves 5% / 25% / 100% with 15-minute observation windows and auto-hold on threshold violation
5) AUTO-ROLLBACK: If any wave breaches combined thresholds (p95 increase AND error-rate increase) trigger immediate rollback and open incident channel
6) POST-APPLY AUDIT: Run regression evals against canonical prompt set and store scoring in the Optimize eval dashboard
7) POSTMORTEM TEMPLATE: Collect timeline, decision logs, telemetry snapshots, and a minimal repro harness to attach to the ticket
verification_criteria: Simulator results show cost improvement with <10% p95 tail risk on tail-heavy slice
Shadow mode p95 delta < 15% and error-rate delta < 0.5% for 30-minute window
All staging waves complete without auto-hold for at least 3x typical traffic variability
Regression eval shows no statistically significant drop in quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-match as appropriate)
